title: Acquirer: Queensland X-Ray Services; Target: Southside Diagnostics Group Radiology

body_sections.Summary: Queensland X-Ray (a wholly owned subsidiary of Sonic Healthcare Limited) proposes to acquire Southside Diagnostic Services Radiology
body_sections.Market definition: The market for the provision of diagnostic imaging services, excluding services to bulk billed public hospital in-patients, in the Sunshine Coast area.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission considered that the proposed acquisition would not appear to lead to a substantial lessening of competition in the market for the provision of diagnostic imaging services, excluding services to bulk billed public hospital in-patients, in the Sunshine Coast area due to: "	It appears that the barriers to entry are not high; "	It appears that there are a number of diagnostic service providers not presently competing in the relevant market which would be able to enter the relevant market easily; "	There are a number of available substitutes who would be able to expand existing operations ; and "	Countervailing power appears to be present among customers including private hospitals and health funds.  Additionally, medical practitioners are able to refer patients to a competing diagnostic imaging provider to assist a new entrant.
